combo_label: Things That Beep × At the Funfair × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Hot kitchen cupboard that pings when the roast demands to come out.
Man who knelt, placed his hands between his lord's, and swore for his holding
Gentleman scholar of Georgian times who sketched ivy-clad ruins and collected deeds
Loud-voiced tout drumming up a crowd for the next attraction
Two riders thundering at each other on opposite sides of a wooden rail
Hospital bedside screen whose steady beep is excellent news.
Belt-clipped relic that beeps doctors out of their lunch break.
Log ride that ends with a splash down a watery chute
Attendant who carried the shield and hoped one day to earn his own spurs
Wooden-headed basher for croquet, or for ringing the strength-test bell
Flat ledge between a wall's foot and the ditch, so spoil cannot slide into it
Tumbling laundry machine that sings out when your towels are toasty.
